description: 국토안전관리원_특수교량 동적 계측 데이터 서비스 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국토안전관리원. 동적 계측 데이터 서비스(DynaMeasureService)는 신호를 100Hz로 측정하여 풍속, 가속도, 변위, 변형률, 처짐 등 다양한 물리적 현상에 대한 데이터를 제공합니다. 이 서비스는 10분 및 일 단위로 최대, 최소, 평균, 표준편차, RMS 값을 산출하여 제공하며, 다양한 센서를 통해 얻은... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국토안전관리원. Its tags are 신호, 측정, 계측데이터, 산출값, 측정데이터. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
